text: TikTok Monthly Offers: record 643 conversions at KES 35, but its daily cost rose from KES 27 to 43 and CTR halved during the week, so the ads are tiring.
TikTok Monthly Offers: pause the 1st-Oct ad copies and "Get more for less – Combo 14th Oct", and let the new 14th-Oct creatives take the budget ("Combo 2 – 14th Oct" leads at KES 35).
TikTok balance hit KES 0 on 18 Oct for the 5th time. Top up and set up automatic payments, or the TikTok ads stop.
Meta Weekly Offers spent only about 78% of the branch budgets. New bi-weekly creatives (11 Oct) cut cost per message from KES 95 to 89.
Weekly Offers, cheapest branches per message: Eldoret KES 65, Nakuru KES 67, KTDA KES 69 (183 messages).

Weekly Offers, dearest branches per message: Starmall KES 179, Meru KES 116, Kakamega KES 110. New creatives for Starmall, Meru, Busia and Kisumu; revive Thika's "Happy hour" (KES 43, lost about 90 messages when paused).
New Bags: new creatives cut cost per message from KES 156 to 105. "La Femme – B&W Video" (15 Oct) is the campaign's best ad ever at KES 40.
New Bags: "Bag of the month – Mini Maya" takes most of the budget at KES 121 a message. No delivery on Sundays, so check the schedule.
Corporate offers (new, 11 Oct, KES 1,000 a day): 99 messages at KES 57, the best messaging rate of any Kenya campaign. Track chats to quotes to orders.
Meta Monthly Offers: "October deals – corporate" carried it (203 messages at KES 51) and was paused 18 Oct. Add a corporate backup ad.
Tanzania: WhatsApp Status is 74% of spend at KES 30 a message, but frequency doubled to 2.7. A new vertical Status creative is needed, and Oct Offers 2 is due a refresh around 20 Oct.
Uganda Instagram was hacked on 17 Oct and Meta Uganda was paused on 18 Oct. X is Uganda's only live paid channel. Link a Ugandan WhatsApp number to the UG Page before relaunching.
X Uganda: about 1,250 website visitors a week, but 8 add-to-carts and 0 purchases in 4 weeks.
Google Performance Max: 39 purchases at $3.75 each (4.9x return on spend). Review on Maximize conversions around 25 Oct.
Google Demand Gen: website users rose from 746 to 4,447 on Maximize clicks, but add-to-carts fell from 26 to 17.
